selection_rationale.selected_KNOWN_POOL_FEED_EXPANSION: POSITIVE: V8 EV preview for X/USDC at 10-2000 USD notionals is all negative (best -$0.184; worst -$0.284). The structural issue is low base fee (1.5%) + low assumed volume + high fixed cost (~$0.19). Better ROI path: expand known pool feed to find higher-fee Meteora DLMM pools (some pools have max_fee=20-30% with active volume) or expand to other AMM protocols (Raydium CLMM, Orca Whirlpools).
selection_rationale.not_10_20U_PROBE_PREFLIGHT_DESIGN: NEGATIVE: V8 partial EV preview for 10/20U X/USDC shows all 10/20U cells negative. Best 10/20U realistic scenario is -$0.247 / -$0.284. Per spec hard rule '10/20U X/USDC probe is NOT worth it under V8 EV model'. Designing a probe for a known-negative-EV pool is wasted work.
selection_rationale.not_PAID_RPC_SETUP: NEGATIVE: SOL/USDC at 15 arrays (21% range, 1050 bins decoded) has 0 bins with liquidity. paid_rpc_setup would need to find where SOL/USDC liquidity actually is. But (a) we don't know the cost-effectiveness, (b) X/USDC alone is insufficient for full 2-pool EV. Deferrable.
